text:
harper: Running into a gnarly onboarding bug in the samplekit: fncall with jsonMode + schema validation passes yields a nested nullable field that becomes a quoted string after an auth-retry. downstream code expects an object and fails fast.

devon: hmm do you have the minimal trace? quick logs help.

harper: pasted sanitized runtime trace:
```
CLIENT -> runtime: fncall order_lookup args={order_id: 9001} auth=expired
RUNTIME -> tool(order-svc): returns "{\"order\": {\"id\":9001, \"meta\": "{\\\"source\\\":\\\"mobile\\\"}"}}"
auth refresh triggered -> retry
RUNTIME -> client: "\"{\\\"order\\\": {\\\"id\\\":9001, \\\"meta\\\": \\\"{\\\\\\\"source\\\\\\\":\\\\\\\"mobile\\\\\\\"}\\\"}}\""
CLIENT recv -> app tries to schema-validate, fails because meta is a string not an object
```

sana: so tool returned a quoted JSON inside a field (meta is itself a JSON string). retry path ended up re-quoting the whole payload. Ugh.

devon: do we still have the old `attemptJsonifyForLogging` helper in the retry wrapper? that was reintroduced in a hotfix last year and might be double-encoding.

harper: looks like it. the wrapper tries to be helpful for logs: `if (typeof payload !== 'string') payload = JSON.stringify(payload)` and then send. if payload already contains quoted strings, a retry logs -> re-serialize path can produce nested quotes.

owen: this is also a schema-validation UX problem: customers use schema validators that assert types strictly. if the SDK returns quoted JSON for nested fields, it masks the real contract mismatch. we should prefer normalization instead of lenient unwrapping by default.

sana: proposed fixes:
- add `coerceStructuredOutput(payload, {jsonMode, contentType})` helper in SDK cores (node/go) that normalizes all structured outputs to native JS/Go types before returning to app. it should be idempotent.
- remove/guard `attemptJsonifyForLogging` inside retry path; logging should not mutate the payload we return to clients.
- add samplekit e2e that simulates token expiry mid-call where tool returns nested JSON strings.
- add a small initial migration note in the onboarding README about legacy tools that return JSON-as-strings.

devon: +1. also add a lint in samplekit CI to flag tooling that returns a JSON string in the contract tests (we can fail fast and tell tool authors to return proper object/array).

replbot: Created INF-5011: "coerceStructuredOutput + retry wrapper idempotency to fix nested JSON string re-quotes" assigned to @devon. Priority: P2. https://tracker.redwood/infr/INF-5011

harper: quick mitigation for teams: overlay a small helper in your app until SDK patches land:
```js
// app-side safeNormalizer
function coerceMaybeString(x) {
  if (typeof x === 'string') {
    try { return JSON.parse(x); } catch { return x }
  }
  return x
}
// run recursively on relevant fields from schema
```

owen: can we also add a `strictJsonMode: true|false` runtime config in the SDK so customers who want strict schema enforcement can opt-in and surface a clear error instead of silent coercion? include it in the samplekit config YAML so onboarding teams can toggle.

sana: sample config snippet I'll add to docs:
```yaml
sdk:
  jsonMode: true
  strictJsonMode: false  # when true, SDK will raise a clear error for mismatched nested types
```

devon: action items I'll take:
1) implement coerceStructuredOutput in node SDK and a matching impl in go-sdk, include unit tests (+ idempotence tests)
2) remove mutation in retry logging path; ensure retry sends same object reference or a deep clone that isn't JSONified for logs
3) add e2e in samplekit simulating token expiry and tool returning nested JSON strings
4) update samplekit README with mitigation and link INF-5011

harper: thanks. parity note: please coordinate with SDK leads so both node and go release minor patches simultaneously. this one breaks PoCs pretty badly.

replbot: INF-5011 updated with HARPER logs and samplekit repro. ETA: node patch M-1 (tomorrow), go patch M-3.

owen: tagging @devex for decision on whether to ship a hotfix samplekit release. leaning hotfix since this impacts onboarding.

sana: agree hotfix for samplekit and minor SDK patches. I'll draft the release notes blurb: include recommended app-side helper and mention `strictJsonMode` opt-in.

harper: leaving repro & schema example in the issue. ping me if you want the customer's failing test case. :pray:
